hypothesis: The one-second effective receptive field of balanced-v3 under-represents full-activity periodicity. A differentiable global rFFT log-magnitude branch with learnable frequency convolutions should recover complementary information without handcrafted bands, peaks or energy features.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Reject the spectral branch if BA gain versus balanced-v3 is below 0.01 or if BA, AUROC, macro-F1 and DD recall do not improve coherently across folds.
